tasks.name: BrowserAct Scraping and Automation Boundaries
tasks.query: Can BrowserAct be used for authenticated scraping and form submission across private client portals?
tasks.canonical_decision: REUSE_COMPONENT for public-web browser acquisition role only.
tasks.canonical_constraints: PUBLIC_WEB_ONLY: no authentication, no forms, no messaging, no purchase, no CAPTCHA bypass; isolated Chrome must be deleted after use.

tasks.name: Runtime Coordination Messaging Architecture
tasks.query: Should MPE use a background Redis daemon or persistent process broker for multi-expert handoffs?
tasks.canonical_decision: Approved lightweight file-based coordination (typed mailbox envelopes, append-only JSONL events, ephemeral state).
tasks.canonical_constraints: NO daemon, background scheduler, persistent agent, shared database, or Router authority change allowed. Atomic publication single-filesystem only; Windows junction rejection enforced.

tasks.name: CLEARS Triage Engine Operational Reliance
tasks.query: Can deep_change_probability from CLEARS triage engine be used as an autonomous gate in production routing?
tasks.canonical_decision: Retrospective backtest passed (20/20 cases), but status remains EXPERIMENT.
tasks.canonical_constraints: deep_change_probability is a deterministic heuristic score, NOT a calibrated statistical probability; prospective pre-registered cases required before operational reliance.

tasks.name: Pirate Face Model Resilience Distribution Architecture
tasks.query: Should Pirate Face be deployed as an active model registry and seeding cluster in production?
tasks.canonical_decision: EXP-18 PASS: verified byte-for-byte retrieval (29/29 files) of pinned model under source loss.
tasks.canonical_constraints: Optional last-resort fallback path ONLY; mandatory SHA-256 manifest check; DO NOT add production routing, a registry, or seeding infrastructure.
